$comment: Template for a per-fund metadata file. The controller fills this file once per fund (lives at <fund-folder>/_FUND-METADATA.json) and updates it when fund facts change. SHINE is fund-agnostic; all fund-specific behavior reads from this file (invariant rule 5).
fund_legal_name: <full legal name, e.g., AAA Coinvest Fund A LP>
structure_type: <e.g., closed-end PE LP | open-end hedge LP | master fund | feeder | AIV | blocker>
$comment_jurisdictions: Subset of the jurisdiction keys in reference/regulatory-corpus/_index.json. Defense subagent walks these.

known_post_balance_sheet_events.type: <e.g., GP change, large redemption, partial wind-down>

$comment_events: Populate when known events have occurred after the fiscal year end. SHINE's reconciler Pattern 09 looks for ASC 855 disclosure of these events.
$comment_evergreen: Controller's accepted-practice findings. Loaded by the orchestrator at Stage 1 and applied during Stage 5f prior-review escalation. Eligible only for LOW or MEDIUM impact findings (per reference/prior-review-escalation.md).
